summary: Deepgram for Startups offers direct applicants a starter award beginning at $1,000 in free API credits, with opportunities to upgrade to tiers worth up to $100,000 as product usage grows; partner referrals can provide enhanced offers. Each grant expires 12 months from issue and covers speech-to-text, text-to-speech and Voice Agent APIs. Applicants must be AI builders or early-stage startups building their own voice-AI product, in production or launching within the next 6 months, committed to active building and community engagement. Agencies or consultants building for clients are excluded. Existing customers and companies that raised more than $10M are reviewed case by case, not automatically excluded. Review typically takes one week; credits are deposited 24–48 hours after acceptance.
claim_steps: Create a Deepgram account at console.deepgram.com and have your Project ID handy.

Apply at deepgram.com/startup-program for your own voice-AI product, in production or launching within 6 months; commit to active building and community engagement. Client-agency/consultancy work is excluded.
Review typically takes about a week. Direct applicants start at $1,000; larger growth tiers are opportunities, not guaranteed. If referred by a partner, check its perks page for the applicable offer.
On acceptance, credits are automatically deposited in your console within 24–48 hours. Use each grant within 12 months of its issue date.
